name: Generalist
description: A smidge of everything -- code, debugging, writing, research, and light data/findings analysis. None of them deeply specialized, unlike the presets below. Good default if you're not sure which specialized preset fits yet, or just want a team broad enough to get started.

name: Coding
description: Python, frontend (HTML/CSS/JS/TS), everything-else language work, debug/QA, and research.

name: Content/Writing
description: Draft, edit, and fact-check articles, posts, or copy.

name: Research/Analysis
description: Dig into a topic, structure the findings, and produce a written report.

name: DevOps/Infrastructure
description: Infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and production incident response.

name: Sales
description: Rep coaching, pipeline reviews, account expansion, and outbound.

name: Marketing
description: Content strategy/copy across channels, plus technical and content SEO.

name: Security
description: Secure code review/threat modeling, plus incident response and forensics.

name: Project Management
description: Planning, tracking, meeting notes, and workflow/ticket hygiene.

name: Finance
description: Bookkeeping/close, financial analysis, FP&A, and tax strategy.

name: Product
description: Roadmap/prioritization, user feedback synthesis, and market/trend research.

name: QA/Testing
description: Test automation, API testing, and accessibility auditing.

name: Business Operations
description: Ops management, business strategy, chief-of-staff-style coordination, and change management.

name: IT Operations
description: SRE, DevOps automation, incident response, networking, and IT service management -- the ops side of running infrastructure, not writing application code.

name: HR & People
description: Onboarding, recruiting, org psychology, and training design.

name: Legal & Compliance
description: Client intake, document review, billing/time tracking, and data privacy.
